_README: Line-range classification of the ORCHESTRATOR-facing prose, for the SPIKE_CONTROLLER_PLAN
step-4 line-delta measurement (Q5). Every line of every listed file is assigned to exactly
one class; measure-delta.js refuses to report a number unless the ranges tile each file
with no gap and no overlap and the file's current length matches. Blank lines are assigned
to the block they sit in, because the code side is counted with `wc -l` and both sides must
C  CONTROLLER  the rule is executed by adws-run.js; the orchestrator model never reads it
again. This is the only class credited to the delta.
A  AGENT       the line instructs a PHASE AGENT, not the orchestrator. It leaves the
orchestrator's context but is NOT replaced by controller code — it belongs
in .claude/agents/*.md, which this spike does not touch.
K  KEPT        the orchestrator model still does this: intake judgment, performing the
dispatch, surfacing a human decision, relaying the verdict.
S  SPLIT       part executes, part stays. Counted as KEPT everywhere. Every judgment call
in this table is resolved toward S/K, so the measured win is a floor.
The classification is a judgment and is published so it can be argued with. measure-delta.js
prints a sensitivity band: what the result becomes if every S block is credited to C, and
what it becomes if every C block that carries no imperative is struck.
